name: Ransomware Lateral Movement
description: A marketing employee opens a malicious 'Q3 invoice' PDF. EDR detects rapid file encryption on the laptop, then the strain spreads over SMB to the HR file share and begins encrypting 38,000 files including employee PII. The dropper is confirmed as the BlackForge (LockBit-family) ransomware.
seed_summary: EDR ALERT log-edr-44120: rapid file encryption on LT-MKT-214 (~1,450 files/min, .forge) after mwilson@company.com executed Q3_Invoice.pdf.exe at 14:02 UTC. Ransom note README_RESTORE.txt dropped.

detection.summary: Rapid mass file-encryption on LT-MKT-214 (mwilson@company.com) following execution of Q3_Invoice.pdf.exe.

timeline.event: Mass file encryption detected on LT-MKT-214
Lateral spread via SMB to HR share FS-HR-01 (~38k files)
Severity CRITICAL — employee PII on FS-HR-01

name: AWS Cloud Cryptojacking
description: A CI/CD IAM access key is accidentally pushed to a public GitHub repository. Within minutes, Datadog flags a spike of GPU EC2 instance creations in an unusual region. The instances run XMRig mining to a Monero pool — financial and compute theft, with no customer or personal data accessed.

detection.summary: 48 GPU EC2 instances launched in ap-south-1 via IAM key AKIA4XMPL3 found exposed in a public GitHub repository.

Leaked IAM key (ci-deploy-bot) traced to public GitHub repo
Startup scripts run XMRig to Monero mining pool

proposed_actions.description: Revoke the leaked IAM access key immediately.
Terminate all rogue GPU EC2 instances.
Disable the compromised IAM principal pending key rotation.
Block the attacker source IP and egress to the mining pool.

feed.content: Synthesis complete: cryptojacking via a leaked IAM key (~$84k/day, no data breach). Kill chain: key exposed in public repo → 48 rogue GPU EC2 instances → XMRig Monero mining. Recommendation: revoke the IAM key, terminate rogue instances, disable the principal, and block the mining pool. Dossier submitted to the Human Security Officer for approval.

timeline.event: 48 GPU EC2 instances launched in ap-south-1
Leaked IAM key (ci-deploy-bot) traced to public GitHub repo
Startup scripts run XMRig to Monero mining pool
No GDPR/CCPA clock — financial / cloud-abuse only
